summary: Self-improvement loop with a check-before-keep gate (AgentRun: capped whole-file corrections with secret-shape refusal, learned workflows compiled after 20 runs, code-checked, dry-run, replayed once, serving only on agreement; one revision for a held draft), durable run store with lease takeover (finished step never re-runs; crash-interrupted write marked interrupted, never silently retried), typed workflows with confidence-scored decisions routed against a threshold, control-plane discipline (server deny holds over never-ask; spend caps pause and state the least needed; unpriceable costs read unknown, never $0), fleet orchestration with worktree isolation (Agent Orchestrator: one task/agent/branch/worktree, feedback routed back to the owning worker until PR approval, reviewer agent before a person, status lanes surfacing what needs a person), harness-agnostic layer (one control plane over pi/Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode), and a skills registry with a PR validation pipeline (claude-code-templates: 1,980+ installable components, merge-not-overwrite CLI, validator plus scanner on every PR, per-source attribution kept, local-only dashboards bound to loopback). Patterns restated in our own words only; no code, no network/wallet/signing/payment/API-key code, no benchmark, performance, star-count, or deployment claims as fact.
